implemented: The response scanner first parses the raw bytes with the same JSON parser used by run_once, then scans the complete parsed object before response_digest can be computed.
Malformed or non-object response representations are refused before any response-derived persistence.

Actual mocked run_once tests cover UTF-16 and UTF-32 HTTP 200 response bytes containing the configured credential in a schema-valid ignored selection field, an ignored outer field, and a nested unicode-encoded field.
Each adversarial case proves SENSITIVE_OUTPUT_REFUSED, response_digest null, no credential in the persisted stream, and a retained claim that blocks retry.
